item.title: What to know about US-Israel attacks on Iran
item.description: The attacks came a day after Trump voiced frustration over lack of progress in negotiations to stop Iran's ability to develop nuclear weapons.

item.title: Woman who falsely accused Duke lacrosse players of rape released from prison after murder conviction
item.description: Crystal Mangum made headlines in 2006 for falsely accusing three Duke lacrosse players of rape.

item.title: Quick Tip: Childcare
item.description: Childcare costs are hitting families hard. A new study from LendingTree finds a family may need to earn more than $400,000 a year to comfortably afford care for two kids.

item.title: Man charged in stabbing death of woman found outside of hotel in Elk Grove Village, police say
item.description: A suburban man is accused of stabbing a woman to death who he was sharing a hotel room with, police said. Her body was found near a dumpster outside the hotel earlier this week.

item.title: ABC7 'Chicago Proud' streaming series showcases heartwarming, uplifting local stories
item.description: ABC7 is taking a look back at some of the most heartwarming and uplifting stories from across our area, along with the positive work so many Chicagoans are doing that truly make us proud of our hometown.

item.title: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, Iran's supreme leader, is dead, Trump says
item.description: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, 86, the supreme leader of Iran, was killed in the U.S.-Israeli attack on the country Saturday, President Donald Trump said.

item.title: 19-year-old man inside home killed in drive-by shooting in Auburn Gresham, Chicago police say
item.description: A 19-year-old man was killed in a drive-by shooting on Chicago's South Side Saturday evening, police said.

item.title: 3 men shot, 1 fatally, inside basement of home in Albany Park, Chicago police say
item.description: Three men were shot inside of a home's basement Saturday on the city's Northwest Side, Chicago police said. A 24-year-old man was killed.

item.title: Person on sidewalk killed in drive-by shooting in Chatham, Chicago police say
item.description: A person on a sidewalk was killed in a drive-by shooting Saturday on the city's South Side, Chicago police said.

item.title: Person stabbed on CTA bus in West Town, Chicago police say
item.description: A person was stabbed on a CTA bus Saturday evening in the city's West Town neighborhood.
